title: AYZEN Frontend Route Circuit Entry
description: Phase 05 (UI-to-Backend Circuit). One entry per authenticated or public route declared in artifacts/ayzen/src/lib/route-config.tsx (ADMIN_ROUTES, USER_ROUTES) or artifacts/ayzen/src/App.tsx's literal <Route> JSX. Built by static regex-based scanning -- not a full TypeScript/JSX AST parse -- so 'resolved' means a lazy import or JSX route mapped cleanly to a page file on disk, and each apiCalls[].backend is a best-effort match against reports/lineage/lineage.json, not a guarantee that the call is the page's only backend dependency. See tools/ui-circuit-validator/build.mjs's header for the heuristic's exact limits.

path.description: Route path as declared, e.g. '/admin/vault' or '/finance/receipt/:token'.

component.description: Component identifier referenced by the route declaration.

pageFile.description: Page file path relative to artifacts/ayzen/src, e.g. 'pages/admin/vault.tsx'. Null when no lazy import resolved the component.

classification.description: Present only when status is 'resolved'. OK: every discovered API call resolved to a backend endpoint. HAS_ORPHAN_CALLS: at least one discovered call did not resolve. MOCK_OR_STATIC_PAGE: no /api/* fetch() call was discovered at all -- heuristic, may be a genuinely static page or a call pattern this scanner does not recognize (see schema description).

path.description: Normalized path with ${...} template segments replaced by ':param'.

raw.description: Path exactly as it appeared in the source fetch() call, before normalization.

backend.description: The matching reports/lineage/lineage.json entry, or null if unresolved.
